Subject: Night Window: Private Deploy Canary & Smoke Acceptance Plan

Team / ACME SRE —

Proposal: run the private deploy canary and smoke acceptance in the 02:00-04:00 PST night window this Friday (quiet traffic). Goal is a minimal blast radius validation of networking, KV warm-up, and end-to-end inference on the private VPC deployment.

Attached: night-window-checklist.xlsx (master checklist), canary-configs.yaml (canary traffic routing rules).

Key ask: owners for each step below and clear go/no-go criteria. Please reply with owners and any blockers by EOD Wednesday.

Minimal plan (high level):
- Pre-window: preflight telemetry sanity, ACL snapshot, BGP neighbor test (external), KV priming plan.
- Window T0 (canary start): route 2% traffic to private cluster; confirm control-plane API and model load success.
- T0+10m: KV warm-up pass (95% of typical hit rate on prefix), token latency under 120ms p50 for small prompt.
- T0+30m: ramp to 10% if no regressions; run scripted smoke prompts and evals.
- Rollback: immediate traffic cut and route back to hosted if any SLO violation or unexplained 500s.

Proposed owners (fill in):
- Network / BGP & ACLs: _____
- KV cache & warmup: _____
- Observability gating: _____
- Canary ops lead: _____

ACME: we need a target maintenance window on your side for peer resets if needed.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Product Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Thanks Soojin — ACME can be available for a night window. A few clarifications from our side:

1) BGP: we can accept a neighbor flapping test but would like to avoid full session resets unless pre-approved by our network ops lead. Please share the exact AS path changes/communities you plan to push.
2) Health endpoints: we need the /healthz and /kv/status endpoints accessible from our peering subnet for the duration of the window.
3) Rollback: if ACME sees >1% packet loss at the edge or repeated BGP resets, we will cut traffic on our side — we need a quick POC callback number.

Attached: acme-peer-checklist.pdf (network gating matrix).

SRE on call: Maya Shah <maya.shah@acme-corp.com>

Thanks — I updated the runbook and added explicit telemetry gates. See kv-primer-steps.md attached and inline notes below.

Runbook snippets (applies in order):
1) Preflight (T-90 to T-10):
   - Snapshot all ACLs and export to S3 (owner: laura_bennett)
   - Baseline latency sample from control-plane and inference-gen nodes (owner: jonas_weber)
   - Confirm peering routes and next-hops with ACME SRE (owner: marissa_cole)

2) Canaries (T0):
   - Launch canary job with the canary-configs.yaml routing (owner: vivek_kulkarni)
   - Validate model load logs include "model_ready" and no OOMs for 20 consecutive requests
   - Start KV priming sequence: 1M tokens of synthetic prefix traffic across target shards (owner: jonas_weber)

3) Gating rules (automated where possible):
   - Observability thresholds: error-rate < 0.5% (5m rolling), p50 latency < 150ms, p95 < 500ms
   - KV hit-rate target: >= 80% on primed prefixes within 20m
   - If gating fails, automatic rollback script (route-cut.sh) will run; manual confirm by ops lead within 5 minutes

Notes: I added an additional smoke check to validate request tracing emits request_id and kv_hint headers so we can correlate missed hits.

Attachments: kv-primer-steps.md (plain text)

--
Jonas Weber
SRE, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

Summary and final signoff checklist (I will own the go/no-go):

Immediate pass criteria (must all be green):
- Peering session OK and route table matches snapshot (owner: marissa_cole)
- /healthz responses return 200 and "ok" within 200ms avg (owner: jonas_weber)
- KV warmup: 80% hit-rate on target prefixes within 20m (owner: jonas_weber)
- No OOMs or repeated 5xx spikes (owner: vivek_kulkarni)
- ACME: no packet-loss or BGP instability observed (ACME SRE signoff: Maya Shah)

Abort conditions (any triggers immediate rollback):
- Error-rate > 1% sustained for 5m
- p95 token latency > 750ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows
- KV hit-rate < 60% after 30m

Signoff flow:
1) Preflight green —> Laura clicks "Start Canary" in the doc (link included in checklist).
2) Vivek monitors first 15m and reports.
3) ACME Maya to provide on-call acknowledgement in the thread.
4) If green at 30m, ramp to 10% and re-evaluate for business hours handoff.

I've attached a pared-down acceptance page to the checklist with signoff checkboxes. Please review and ack.

Laura Bennett
Operations Lead, Private Deploys
Redwood Inference
